MERGE INTO DI_ORDER_CHANGE A USING ( SELECT #PO_CREATE_DATE# AS PO_CREATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(#PO_CREATE_SEQ#,'FM00000') AS PO_CREATE_SEQ FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1=1 AND B.PO_CREATE_DATE = A.PO_CREATE_DATE AND B.PO_CREATE_SEQ = A.PO_CREATE_SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ZPO_REVISE_NO = #ZPO_REVISE_NO#, LIFNR = #LIFNR#, LOEKZ = #LOEKZ#, ZSTAT = #ZSTAT#, BLDAT = #BLDAT#, ZREVIND = #ZREVIND#, WERKS = #WERKS#, EBELN_C = #EBELN_C#, EBELP_C = #EBELP_C#, EBELN_PO = #EBELN_PO#, EBELP_PO = #EBELP_PO#, MATNR = #MATNR#, MENGE_O = #MENGE_O#, MENGE_N = #MENGE_N#, MENGE_GR = #MENGE_GR#, MEINS = #MEINS#, NETPR_O = #NETPR_O#, PEINH_O = #PEINH_O#, EBELN_PN = #EBELN_PN#, EBELP_PN = #EBELP_PN#, NETPR_N = #NETPR_N#, PEINH_N = #PEINH_N#, WAERS = #WAERS#, LOEKZI = #LOEKZI#, EINDT_O = #EINDT_O#, EINDT_N = #EINDT_N#, MAKTX = #MAKTX#, TYPE = #TYPE_CD#, ZREASON = #ZREASON#, VCONDT = #VCONDT#, DCONDT = #DCONDT#, CREATE_DATE = SYSDATE, FILE_NAME = #FILE_NAME# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PO_CREATE_DATE, PO_CREATE_SEQ, ZPO_REVISE_NO, LIFNR, LOEKZ, ZSTAT, BLDAT, ZREVIND, WERKS, EBELN_C, EBELP_C, EBELN_PO, EBELP_PO, MATNR, MENGE_O, MENGE_N, MENGE_GR, MEINS, NETPR_O, PEINH_O, EBELN_PN, EBELP_PN, NETPR_N, PEINH_N, WAERS, LOEKZI, EINDT_O, EINDT_N, MAKTX, TYPE, ZREASON, VCONDT, DCONDT, CREATE_DATE, FILE_NAME ) VALUES ( #PO_CREATE_DATE#, TO_CHAR(#PO_CREATE_SEQ#,'FM00000'), #ZPO_REVISE_NO#, #LIFNR#, #LOEKZ#, #ZSTAT#, #BLDAT#, #ZREVIND#, #WERKS#, #EBELN_C#, #EBELP_C#, #EBELN_PO#, #EBELP_PO#, #MATNR#, #MENGE_O#, #MENGE_N#, #MENGE_GR#, #MEINS#, #NETPR_O#, #PEINH_O#, #EBELN_PN#, #EBELP_PN#, #NETPR_N#, #PEINH_N#, #WAERS#, #LOEKZI#, #EINDT_O#, #EINDT_N#, #MAKTX#, #TYPE_CD#, #ZREASON#, #VCONDT#, #DCONDT#, SYSDATE, #FILE_NAME#
)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE if_podt SET status = 'D', if_flag = 'N', load_date = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), load_time = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE buyer = 'KRDOOS0099' AND legacy_po_no = #EBELN_PO# AND legacy_po_seq= #EBELP_PO#

UPDATE if_podt SET status = 'R', item_qty = #ITEM_QTY#, item_amt = #ITEM_QTY# * unit_price, rd_date = REPLACE(#EINDT_N#,'-',''), if_flag = 'N', load_date = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), load_time = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE buyer = 'KRDOOS0099' AND legacy_po_no = #EBELN_PO# AND legacy_po_seq= #EBELP_PO#
UPDATE if_progress SET if_flag = 'C' WHERE buyer = 'KRDOOS0099' AND legacy_no = #EBELN_PO# AND GUBUN = 'PO'
